<!--
// onsu : sear
function onsuSear() {
	ajax("", "", "", "", $("#SC_word").val(), "");
	return false;
}

// oncl : sear
function onclSear() {
	$("#frmSear").submit();
}

function onch_SC() {
	ajax($("#SC_LP").val(), $("#SC_YEAR").val(), $("#SC_SUPPLY").val(), $("#SC_LOCAL").val(), "", "");
}

function oncl_SC(val1, val2, val3, val4) {
	ajax(val1, val2, val3, val4, "", "");
	//window.location.href = "../board/perform.list.php?BBS_GUBUN=1&SC_LP=" + val1 + "&SC_YEAR=" + val2 + "&SC_SUPPLY=" + val3 + "&SC_LOCAL=" + val4;
}

function ajax(SC_LP, SC_YEAR, SC_SUPPLY, SC_LOCAL, SC_word, page) {
	if(page == "") {
		if(SC_LP != "" || SC_YEAR != "" || SC_SUPPLY != "" || SC_LOCAL != "") {
			SC_word = "";

			if (SC_LP != "") $('#SC_LP').parent().addClass('on');
			else $('#SC_LP').parent().removeClass('on');
			if (SC_YEAR != "") $('#SC_YEAR').parent().addClass('on');
			else $('#SC_YEAR').parent().removeClass('on');
			if (SC_SUPPLY != "") $('#SC_SUPPLY').parent().addClass('on');
			else $('#SC_SUPPLY').parent().removeClass('on');
			if (SC_LOCAL != "") $('#SC_LOCAL').parent().addClass('on');
			else $('#SC_LOCAL').parent().removeClass('on');
		} else if(SC_word != "") {
			SC_LP = "";
			SC_YEAR = "";
			SC_SUPPLY = "";
			SC_LOCAL = "";

			$('.slt_wrap').removeClass('on');
		} else {
			SC_LP = "";
			SC_YEAR = "";
			SC_SUPPLY = "";
			SC_LOCAL = "";
			SC_word = "";

			$('.slt_wrap').removeClass('on');
		}
	}

	$.ajax({ url: '../json/perform.list.php', type: 'POST', dataType: 'html',
		data: {
			BBS_GUBUN: "1",
			SC_LP: ((SC_LP == "ALL") ? "" : SC_LP) ,
			SC_YEAR: ((SC_YEAR == "ALL") ? "" : SC_YEAR),
			SC_SUPPLY: ((SC_SUPPLY == "ALL") ? "" : SC_SUPPLY),
			SC_LOCAL: ((SC_LOCAL == "ALL") ? "" : SC_LOCAL),
			SC_word : SC_word,
			page: page
		}
	})
	.done(function(html) {
		$arr.off();


		if(page == "") {
			if(SC_LP != "" || SC_YEAR != "" || SC_SUPPLY != "" || SC_LOCAL != "") {
				$("#SC_word").val("");
			} else if(SC_word != "") {
				$("#SC_LP").val("");
				$("#SC_YEAR").val("");
				$("#SC_SUPPLY").val("");
				$("#SC_LOCAL").val("");
			} else {
				$("#SC_LP").val("");
				$("#SC_YEAR").val("");
				$("#SC_SUPPLY").val("");
				$("#SC_LOCAL").val("");
				$("#SC_word").val("");
			}
		}

		$("#div_ajax").html(html);


		$('#div_ajax img.lazy').each(function() {
			$(this).css ( { display:"block" , opacity:0 } ).delay ( Math.random()*700 ).animate ( { opacity:1 } , 600 );
		});


		$arr = $('.project_lst_wrap [class*="arr_"]');

		$arr.mouseover(function() {
			$(this).css({opacity:1});
		}).mouseleave(function() {
			$(this).css({opacity:0.5});
		});

		if ($arr.length > 0) project_arr();
	});
}

function projRead(o) {
	if (o.c == '' || o.t == '') return;
	var z = [];
	z.title = o.t;
	z.url = '../board/perform.read.php?BBS_GUBUN=1&BBS_IDX='+o.c;
	z.ww = '1100px';
	z.hh = '90%';
	z.onclose = 'projClose()';
	secondViewOpen(z);

	$('.project_lst_wrap [class*="arr"]').css({opacity:0});
}

function projClose() {
	$('.project_lst_wrap [class*="arr"]').css({opacity:1});
}

function proj_resize() {
	var t = $('.modal').attr('style');
	$('.modal').attr('style', '');
	$('.modal').attr('style', t)
}
